brief.t: START HERE: Forward the Optiphen Plus COA to Sam and QC and ask them to match the lot and resolve the conflicting entries before clearance.

ACT NOW 1: Optiphen Plus COA: resolve document exception before clearance. Email visually checked order320092 Optiphen Plus COA batch0002751898-18586: acid value5.9 versus specification25.0–37.5; phenol29.7ppm versus maximum6ppm. New finding today from documents received yesterday. These entries may be a document error, not a proven tested-lot failure, PLL receipt or production block. QC must match actual lots and determine disposition; separate PE9010 gap remains. Send internally: Sam and QC, please review the Optiphen Plus COA for batch 0002751898-18586 today, match it to our material and confirm disposition; the listed results conflict with its specifications, so please do not treat this document as cleared.

ACT NOW 2: Sea buckthorn: confirm the existing order and arrival. Michael and Evelyn have waited 1 day for 3.2 kg more to continue production. NatureInBottle order 1793377149822 already covers 5 kg seed oil; a $283.32 PayPal payment notice exists. Dispatch, arrival, project linkage and QC release remain unverified. Talova #49 instead lists berry/fruit oil; do not substitute or place a duplicate order. Send internally: Evelyn and Michael, please match the 5 kg seed oil order to your request and confirm the project, specification and latest usable-arrival date today before we buy anything else.

ACT NOW 3: Oreka: close Nadia's delivery loop today. Nadia's response task is 17 days overdue. Her Canada window ends tomorrow, November 1. CRM still shows sample batching; no verified finished-sample QC release or delivery. Mibelle raw-material tracking is not finished-sample shipment proof. Send internally: Michael and Steve, please confirm Oreka's finished samples and delivery status today; if Canada is no longer feasible, give me the revised destination and date for Nadia.
